Corporate Finance · 2026 Tree Gallery · Home for the Howlidays

Lookbook: every element against the board

The goal: a tree the committee can buy and build exactly as the preview shows, with every element a true match to the inspiration board, shown side by side before anything is ordered. Each element below is the closest match we found; every other option is one tap away in the 3D page's Swap pieces, with its price.

13 match · 1 closeof the board's 14 elements (2 extras off)
$1,889.68board match, incl. GST and shipping
$110.32left of $2,000 (floor: $75)
Not yetverified today: the Amazon checks run in the Chrome session (CLAUDE.md)

The judgments I made

You asked me to decide; here is each call and why. All of them are reversible in Swap pieces.

  1. Topper: Tied from 6" natural jute (B0DQ4BXYKZ), two loops and two tails, 22" across: the board's shape and ribbon width. No paw-print burlap is sold wider than 2.5", so 20 black felt paws are glued on, cut from the felt we already buy (saves $29 against iron-on transfers and needs no iron). Floral wire glued along the edges lets the unwired jute hold its loops.
  2. Pets: Kept the 12" Cuddlekins golden retriever. Replaced the 4.7" kittens with the 8" FLUFFYFUN grey-and-white tabby, the closest sitting tabby at the board's scale. A dog and a cat sit together under the tree, recreating the board's dog-and-cat photo.
  3. Doghouses: Built at the board's scale: six 10" foam-board doghouses (10 boards) instead of twelve 4.3" ones. Two face the front, like the board.
  4. Paw ornaments: Ten 6" ornaments: a DeSerres embroidery hoop painted gold (its brass screw reads as the bauble cap), ivory Aida for the woven cream face, a black glitter-cardstock paw, and a bow hand-tied from dark red wired velvet (MEEDEE). Replaces 30 flat 4" wood rounds and three packs of mini bows.
  5. Bones: Eight 9" clay bones instead of twenty-four 5" ones: the board's size. The two bags of clay still cover the bones and the 60 biscuits.
  6. Baubles: Big balls at the board's 4-6" scale: plain 6" reds (Benjia), 4" red glitter, 4" JOYIN reds and golds, the green glitter and champagne sets, and one 100-pc set to fill. Dropped the second 100-pc set, the champagne 100-pc set and the painted 3.15" reds.
  7. Gifts: Cream burlap ribbon and bows on the gifts, as on the board (1.5" x 20 yd, $18.39), instead of velvet. Tartan paper on three boxes, kraft paw paper on the fourth.
  8. Velvet: The 2.5" velvet roll and the 12 bought velvet bows are gone: the board shows no velvet bows on the tree, and its velvet is on the paw ornaments and the jar.
  9. Giant doghouse, streamers, gold crown: Off by default: none of them are on the board. Each stays one tap away in Swap pieces.
